subject: executor: Add session variable for hash join v2 (#56023)
summary: Reviewed the added sysvar `tidb_hash_join_version` (validation + `SetSession` -> `SessionVars.UseHashJoinV2`), and the executor-side gate in `pkg/executor/builder.go` (`UseHashJoinV2` + env support + `CanUseHashJoinV2`). Also checked SET_VAR hint plumbing restores via `SessionVars.SetSystemVar(...)` so the boolean side-effect is applied both when setting and restoring. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, session/transaction, or SQL-semantics issues found for the touched `executor`/`sessionctx` paths; later upstream history contains follow-up refactors/features around this var but no fix indicating a Blocker/High in this commit.
